text:
B: Afternoon! Gary. How you doing?
A: Oh, hello. Erm, fine, thanks. I'm Joanne.
B: Joanne, lovely. Is that a cockapoo I can see at the bottom there?
A: Oh, yes, sorry, that's Biscuit. He's asleep.
B: No way, we've got one! Bailey. Little monkey chewed one of my slippers to bits this week. Brand new and all, Karen got me them for Christmas.
A: Oh no. Biscuit's past the chewing stage, thankfully. He's quite old now. It's mostly his stomach we worry about.
B: Karen does most of the walking, if I'm honest. I'm out on the road. Senior sales, industrial fixings. Fifty-odd hours a week, Midlands patch. Where are you based?
A: Basingstoke. I'm a planner at the borough council.
B: A planner! You're the lot that turned my mate's double garage down, then.
A: Erm, probably not personally. Not if he's in the Midlands.
B: Ha, fair point. Walsall council, it was. He was fuming for weeks.
A: It does happen. Sometimes people are told no for good reasons and sometimes, honestly, it's a close call. I always try to explain it straight. I'd rather someone was annoyed with me than misled.
B: That's fair, that. I'm the opposite in my game, mind. You tell the buyer what he wants to hear and sort the detail later. Only joking. Mostly.
A: I deal with a few people like that. Developers, mainly. Sorry, that sounded rude.
B: No, no, I'll take it. Do you work from home, then?
A: Three days at home, two in the office. I like the home days. Radio on, a pile of extensions, a cup of tea.
B: Can't do home. I'd go stir crazy. I'm happiest in the car. Got a 5 Series, keep it spotless, valeted every fortnight. Do you get away much, holidays?
A: Erm, Cornwall, mostly. Same cottage near the same village, every year. It's dog-friendly. It's not very exciting.
B: Nothing wrong with that. We do all-inclusive, Tenerife, Turkey. I did Dubai for my fiftieth, mind. Got upgraded to a suite. Do you not fancy the sun?
A: We went to Lake Garda once and it was lovely, but I find the flights quite stressful. And the packing. I always forget something.
B: Karen's the same. She does a list. I just chuck it all in the night before.
A: Gosh, I couldn't do that. I'd be up all night. Erm, what do you do at weekends?
B: Golf, Sunday mornings. Same three lads. Handicap's about fourteen on a good day. You?
A: Dog walks. Jigsaws in winter. I'm not sure that's very helpful, sorry.
B: Sounds alright to me. Peaceful. Right, I think that's us. Lovely chatting, Joanne. Give Biscuit a pat from Bailey.
A: I will. Nice to meet you, Gary.
B: Tara, then.
